aspect: Consent is a condition of employment
description: Agreement is given at hiring, in a document that cannot be negotiated, by someone who needs the job.
energy_note: Consented to, in the sense that refusing meant no job.

aspect: The data is used for things it was not collected for
description: Gathered for security, produced at a disciplinary, or used to evidence a capability case.
energy_note: Collected for one reason, produced for another.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the idle time report
description: 'You were inactive 41 minutes on Tuesday.' She was on the phone to a client, on her mobile, because the desk phone was broken and she had reported it twice.
energy_note: Forty-one minutes of working, recorded as nothing.
